projects.title: Life Expectancy Prediction
projects.description: Built an end-to-end ML pipeline to predict life expectancy from WHO socio-economic and health indicators. Benchmarked 7 regression models and deployed the best-performing model as an interactive Gradio web app with SHAP-based explainability.
highlights: Benchmarked 7 regression models (Linear, Ridge, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, LightGBM) under identical preprocessing and evaluation metrics.
Identified Random Forest as the best-performing model for life expectancy prediction.
Implemented SHAP for global feature importance and local prediction explanations.
Deployed the model as an interactive Gradio web app for real-time inference.

projects.title: FoodBridge AI
projects.description: Developed a microservices platform connecting food donors with local NGOs, utilizing machine learning for predictive freshness and algorithmic NGO matching.
highlights: Engineered a RandomForest model to predict food freshness and spoilage timelines, tuned with GridSearchCV and 5-fold cross-validation.
Developed a custom recommendation engine using Cosine Similarity for food type matching and the Haversine formula for geographic prioritization.
Designed a clean Service-Repository backend in FastAPI with a strict 4-stage state machine to track physical food pickups.
